run.question: I need to find a field in the app-193-telemetry index that's used for tracking transactions. The field name should contain 'transaction'. Can you search the mappings and tell me the exact field name?

report.summary: The only field in app-193-telemetry whose name contains 'transaction' is du_transaction_id_7k3m, mapped as type text with a keyword multi-field (ignore_above 256). A sampled document carries the field with value "TXN-98765", so the mapping is in use rather than merely declared. No fault, change or impact is at issue; this was a read-only schema lookup.

claims.text: In index app-193-telemetry, the top-level mapping property names matching 'transaction' (case-insensitive) are exactly ['du_transaction_id_7k3m'].

A recursive scan of the mapping for any path containing 'transaction' returns only paths under properties.du_transaction_id_7k3m (its type, and its fields.keyword type and ignore_above), so no other nested field name contains 'transaction'.
One document in app-193-telemetry (_id lfiM_KEBFz7Q4KB3k0s_) has du_transaction_id_7k3m = "TXN-98765"; the index reported docs.count 1, so this sample covers the index's only document at query time.

gaps: The initial unfiltered elasticsearch_mappings call for pattern app-193-telemetry* returned RESULT_TOO_LARGE (140612 tokens, status error), so the field list reported here comes from jq-filtered reads of the mapping, not a full dump; fields whose names lack 'transaction' were therefore not enumerated.

Mappings and document counts were read at query time (2026-11-21T05:20:45Z to 2026-11-21T05:20:55Z) and cannot prove the schema or document contents at earlier times; the single-document sample was time-filtered to @timestamp 2026-11-21T04:20:43Z to 05:20:43Z.
Change history is not integrated in this Run, so when or why this field was added could not be checked.
next_steps: If a full inventory of the index's fields is needed, page through the stored mapping evidence or query narrower jq field selections rather than the whole mapping.
